text: The capital of Pakistan is Islamabad.
The founder of Pakistan is Quaid e Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah.
The national poet of Pakistan is Allama Iqbal.
The national language of Pakistan is Urdu.
The flag of Pakistan is green and white with a star and crescent.
The national animal of Pakistan is the Markhor.
The national bird of Pakistan is the Chukar.
The national flower of Pakistan is Jasmine, called Chambeli.
The national tree of Pakistan is the Deodar.
The national fruit of Pakistan is the Mango.
The national sport of Pakistan is field hockey.
Pakistan became independent on the fourteenth of August nineteen forty seven.
The national anthem of Pakistan is the Qaumi Taranah.
The money of Pakistan is the Pakistani Rupee.
The largest city of Pakistan is Karachi.
The highest mountain in Pakistan is K2.
The major river of Pakistan is the River Indus.
The national dress of Pakistan is the shalwar kameez.
The national mosque of Pakistan is the Faisal Mosque.
The religion of most people in Pakistan is Islam.
The national monument of Pakistan is the Pakistan Monument in Islamabad.
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Its capital is Peshawar.
Gilgit Baltistan. Its capital is Gilgit.
Azad Kashmir. Its capital is Muzaffarabad.
Islamabad is the federal capital territory.
Quaid e Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah founded Pakistan in 1947.
Allama Iqbal is the national poet who dreamed of Pakistan.
Fatima Jinnah is known as the mother of the nation.
Abdul Sattar Edhi spent his life helping poor and sick people.
Arfa Karim became the youngest Microsoft certified professional.
Sir Syed Ahmed Khan worked hard to give Muslims good education.
Liaquat Ali Khan was the first Prime Minister of Pakistan.
Doctor Abdus Salam won the Nobel Prize in Physics.
Doctor Abdul Qadeer Khan was a famous Pakistani scientist.
Jahangir Khan was a great squash champion of the world.
Wasim Akram is one of the greatest cricketers of Pakistan.
Malala Yousafzai won the Nobel Peace Prize for girls education.
Major Aziz Bhatti was a brave soldier who received Nishan e Haider.
Rashid Minhas was a brave young pilot of the Pakistan Air Force.
Doctor Ruth Pfau spent her life helping sick people in Pakistan.
Faisal Mosque is a very large and beautiful mosque in Islamabad.
Minar e Pakistan is a tall tower in Lahore.
The Badshahi Mosque is a grand old mosque in Lahore.
Lahore Fort is a very old royal fort in Lahore.
Mazar e Quaid is the tomb of Quaid e Azam in Karachi.
The Pakistan Monument is a flower shaped landmark in Islamabad.
K2 is the highest mountain of Pakistan in Gilgit Baltistan.
Nanga Parbat is a very tall and famous mountain.
The Khyber Pass is a famous mountain pass in the north.
Hunza is a beautiful green valley in the mountains.
Swat is a green valley called the Switzerland of Pakistan.
Saif ul Malook is a beautiful lake near Naran.
Attabad Lake has bright blue water in Hunza.
Mohenjo daro is a very old city in Sindh.
Clifton is a famous sea beach in Karachi.
Derawar Fort is a large desert fort near Bahawalpur.
Rohtas Fort is a strong old fort near Jhelum.
Wazir Khan Mosque is famous for its colourful tile work.
Naltar is a green valley famous for its colourful lakes.
The Clock Tower is a famous old landmark in Faisalabad.
Lion. King of the jungle. It roars loudly.
Elephant. The biggest land animal with a long trunk.
Cow. It gives us milk and says moo.
Goat. It eats grass and gives milk.
Dog. A loyal friend that says woof.
Cat. A soft pet that says meow.
Horse. It runs very fast and we can ride it.
Camel. Ship of the desert. It can go long without water.
Sheep. It gives us soft wool.
Donkey. It carries heavy loads for us.
Buffalo. A big animal that gives lots of milk.
Rabbit. It has long ears and loves carrots.
Monkey. It loves bananas and climbs trees.
Tiger. A big striped cat that is very strong.
Bear. A big furry animal that loves honey.
Deer. It runs fast and has pretty horns.
Fox. A clever animal with a bushy tail.
Wolf. It lives in a group and howls.
Zebra. A horse with black and white stripes.
Giraffe. It has the longest neck of all.
Kangaroo. It jumps and keeps its baby in a pocket.
Panda. A black and white bear that eats bamboo.
Squirrel. A small animal with a fluffy tail.
Pig. A pink animal that says oink.
Mouse. A tiny animal that likes cheese.
Crocodile. It lives in water with big sharp teeth.

Peacock. It dances and has colourful feathers.
Rooster. It crows loudly in the morning.
Chick. A baby hen, soft and yellow.
Duck. It swims in water and says quack.
Swan. A white bird with a long neck.
Pigeon. A peaceful bird that coos softly.
Eagle. It flies very high in the sky.
Owl. It stays awake at night.

Crow. A black bird that says caw caw.
Penguin. It lives in cold places and cannot fly.
Flamingo. A pink bird that stands on one leg.

Cuckoo. It sings a sweet song.
Myna. A clever bird that can talk.
Nightingale. It sings beautifully at night.
Hoopoe. A bird with a pretty crown on its head.

Mango. The king of fruits and a Pakistani favourite.

Grapes. Tiny sweet fruits that grow in bunches.

Melon. A sweet juicy summer fruit.

Dates. Sweet brown fruit we love in Ramadan.
Carrot. An orange vegetable good for our eyes.
Potato. We make chips and curry from it.

Onion. It makes our food tasty.
Spinach. A green leafy vegetable that makes us strong.
Corn. Yellow seeds we love to eat boiled.
Capsicum. A green vegetable, slightly sweet.
Brinjal. A purple vegetable for yummy curry.
Broccoli. A green tree-shaped healthy vegetable.
Cucumber. A cool green vegetable for salad.
Garlic. It adds great smell and taste to food.
Ginger. It is good for cough and cold.
Peas. Tiny green balls inside a pod.
Chili. A hot and spicy vegetable.
Sweet Potato. A sweet vegetable we eat roasted.
Pumpkin. A big round orange vegetable.
Cabbage. A round vegetable with many leaves.
Radish. A white vegetable, crunchy and fresh.
Okra. A green vegetable, also called lady finger.
Car. It has four wheels and takes us places.
Taxi. A yellow car we can hire for a ride.
Bus. A big vehicle that carries many people.
Truck. It carries heavy goods on the road.
Train. It runs on tracks and is very long.
Airplane. It flies high up in the sky.
Helicopter. It flies with spinning blades on top.
Bicycle. We pedal it with our legs.
Scooter. A small and easy two-wheeler.
Boat. It floats and moves on water.
Ship. A very big boat for the sea.
Ambulance. It takes sick people to hospital fast.
Fire Truck. It puts out fires with water.
Police Car. It helps keep everyone safe.
Tractor. Farmers use it in the fields.
Rickshaw. A small three-wheeler for short rides.
Van. It carries a small group of people.
Speed Boat. A fast boat that zooms on water.
Cable Car. It carries us over the mountains.

Hair. It grows on our head.
Eyes. We see the world with our eyes.
Ear. We hear sounds with our ears.
Nose. We smell with our nose.
Mouth. We eat and talk with our mouth.

Bones. They make our body strong.

Say Salam. Greet others with Assalam-o-Alaikum.
Say Thank You. Thank people when they help you.
Say Sorry. Say sorry when you make a mistake.
Say Please. Say please when you ask for something.
Listen Well. Listen quietly when others speak.
Share. Share your toys and food with others.
Respect Elders. Be kind and obey your parents.
Speak Politely. Always talk in a soft, kind voice.
Help Others. Help your friends and family.
Wait Your Turn. Be patient and wait in line.
Be Truthful. Always tell the truth.
Don't Fight. Solve problems with kind words.
Smile. A smile makes everyone happy.
Say Excuse Me. Say excuse me to pass politely.
Be Kind to Animals. Love and care for animals.
Keep Promises. Always do what you promise.
Don't Interrupt. Let others finish speaking first.
Forgive. Forgive your friends with a big heart.
Be Grateful. Thank Allah for everything you have.
Respect Teachers. Greet and obey your teachers.
Wash Hands. Wash hands before and after eating.
Brush Teeth. Brush your teeth twice a day.
Take a Bath. Take a bath to stay fresh and clean.
Cut Nails. Keep your nails short and clean.
Use the Bin. Throw trash in the dustbin.
Clean Clothes. Wear clean and tidy clothes.
Comb Hair. Comb your hair neatly every day.
Wash Face. Wash your face in the morning.
Cover Your Cough. Cover your mouth when you cough.
Use a Tissue. Use a tissue to wipe your nose.
Wash Fruits. Wash fruits before eating them.
Make Your Bed. Tidy your bed every morning.
Tidy Your Toys. Put your toys back after playing.
Wash Feet. Wash your feet to keep them clean.
Clean Your Shoes. Keep your shoes neat and clean.
Don't Spit Around. Never spit on the floor or road.
Clean Your Desk. Keep your study desk tidy.
Wash After Play. Wash up after playing outside.
Drink Clean Water. Drink only clean and safe water.
Keep Home Clean. Help keep your home neat and clean.
Traffic Lights. Red means stop, green means go.
Cross Carefully. Hold an elder’s hand to cross the road.
Stay Away from Fire. Never play with fire or matches.
No Sockets. Do not touch electric sockets.
No Strangers. Do not go with people you don’t know.
Wear Seatbelt. Always wear your seatbelt in a car.
Wear a Helmet. Wear a helmet when riding a bike.
Don't Run on Stairs. Walk slowly on stairs.
Hot Things. Stay away from hot food and pans.
Sharp Things. Do not touch knives and scissors.
Swim with an Adult. Only swim when a grown-up is near.
Look Both Ways. Look left and right before crossing.
Emergency Number. Call for help in an emergency.
Stay Close. Stay near your family in a crowd.
Medicine Is Not Candy. Never eat medicine without an elder.
Don't Climb High. Do not climb on high or unsafe places.
Care for Cuts. Tell an elder if you get hurt.
Don't Touch Stray Animals. Keep away from unknown animals.
Tell an Adult. Tell a grown-up if something is wrong.
Be Careful Near Cars. Never play on the road.
Drink Milk. Milk makes our bones strong.
Eat Fruits. Fruits keep us healthy.
Eat Vegetables. Vegetables give us vitamins.
Drink Water. Drink plenty of clean water daily.
Eat Eggs. Eggs help us grow strong.
Eat on Time. Eat your meals at the right time.
Don't Skip Breakfast. Breakfast gives energy for the day.
Less Sugar. Too many sweets are bad for teeth.
Less Junk Food. Eat home food more than junk food.
Eat Slowly. Chew your food slowly and well.
Eat Dates. Dates are sweet and full of energy.
Eat Honey. Honey is sweet and healthy.
Eat Yogurt. Yogurt is good for our tummy.
Eat Nuts. Nuts make our brain sharp.
Eat Fish. Fish is good for the brain.
Eat Chicken. Chicken helps our muscles grow.
Eat Rice. Rice gives us energy to play.
Eat Bread. Bread is a healthy daily food.
Eat Carrots. Carrots are good for our eyes.
Eat Greens. Green leaves make us strong.
A poor woodcutter lived near a river. He worked hard every day.
One day his axe fell into the deep river. He sat and cried.
An angel came with a golden axe. "Is this yours?" she asked.
The woodcutter said, "No, mine was made of iron."
The angel smiled and gave him all three axes as a reward.
He went home happy. Honesty always brings good things!
What did the angel bring first?
A fast hare always bragged. He laughed at the slow tortoise.
The tortoise said, "Let us have a race!"
The hare ran fast but then took a nap under a tree.
The tortoise walked slowly but never stopped.
The hare woke up but the tortoise had already won!
Slow and steady wins the race. Never give up!
A boy looked after sheep on a hill every day.
He shouted, "Wolf! Wolf!" but there was no wolf.
Villagers ran to help but found nothing. They were angry.
He did it again. Nobody believed him anymore.
Then a real wolf came! Nobody came to help.
That is what happens when you tell lies.
What happened with the real wolf?
On a hot day, a thirsty crow looked for water.
He found a pitcher but water was at the bottom.
His beak was too short. He thought of a plan.
He dropped pebbles into the pitcher one by one.
The water rose up! The crow drank and flew away happy.
What did the crow drop in the pitcher?
Why could the crow not drink at first?
A big lion was sleeping in the forest.
A tiny mouse ran over the lion. The lion woke up angry.
The lion caught the mouse but let him go.
Later hunters caught the lion in a net.
The little mouse came and cut the net with his teeth.
The lion was free! Small friends can do big things.
In summer, the ant worked hard collecting food.
The grasshopper sang and played all day.
"Why work so hard?" asked the grasshopper.
Winter came. The grasshopper had no food.
The ant shared her food with the grasshopper.
Work hard today so you are ready for tomorrow!
Ali had many colorful crayons. Sara had none.
Sara felt sad and could not draw a picture.
Ali shared his crayons with Sara.
They drew a beautiful rainbow together.
Both children smiled and had so much fun!
Sharing makes everyone happy. Be kind!
A dog found a tasty bone and walked home happily.
He saw his reflection in the water.
He thought another dog had a bigger bone.
He barked to grab it and dropped his own bone.
His bone sank in the water. He had nothing now.
Do not be greedy. Be happy with what you have!
Ahmed loved eating sweets and chocolates.
He never wanted to brush his teeth at night.
His teeth started to hurt. He could not eat well.
The dentist said, "Brush twice every day!"
Ahmed brushed morning and night. His teeth felt great!
Clean teeth keep you healthy and happy!
What did Ahmed love to eat?
Fatima wanted a glass of water from her mother.
She said, "Please give me water, Mama."
Her mother smiled and gave her the water.
Fatima said, "Thank you so much, Mama!"
Please and thank you are magic words. Use them!
What magic words did she use?
Hassan saw his mother cleaning the house.
He picked up his toys and put them away.
He helped set the table for dinner.
His parents were so proud of him.
Hassan felt happy helping his family.
Always help your parents. They love you!
Zain always left food on his plate.
His grandmother told him about hungry children.
Zain learned that many children have no food.
He started eating everything on his plate.
He thanked Allah before every meal.
Do not waste food. It is a precious blessing!
What did Zain leave on his plate?
Who told him about hungry children?
A little bird fell from its nest in the tree.
Amina found the bird on the ground.
She gently picked it up and gave it water.
She put the bird back in its nest.
Be kind to animals. They need our love!
What did Amina give the bird?
Omar's room was very messy with toys everywhere.
He could not find his school bag.
His mother said, "Let us clean together!"
They put toys in boxes and made the bed.
Omar found his bag and felt so proud!
A clean room helps you think and sleep better!
What was everywhere in Omar's room?
The wind and the sun had a contest.
They wanted to make a man take off his coat.
The wind blew very hard but the man held his coat.
Then the sun shone warmly and gently.
The man felt warm and took off his coat himself.
Kindness wins over force. Be gentle and kind!
What did they want the man to remove?
He found a pot with only a little water at the bottom.
His beak could not reach the water.
The clever crow dropped small stones into the pot.
The water rose up high, and the crow drank happily.
Where there is a will, there is a way!
What was the crow looking for?
What did the crow drop in the pot?
Ali saw a little sparrow fallen from its nest.
The sparrow was scared and could not fly.
Ali gently picked it up and gave it water.
He put the sparrow back in its warm nest.
The mother bird chirped a happy thank you.
Allah loves those who are kind to His creatures!
What did Ali give the sparrow?
When young, Quaid-e-Azam loved to study hard.
He told his friends to play fair and never cheat.
He always spoke the truth, even when it was hard.
With hard work, he helped create Pakistan in 1947.
Work hard and be honest, like the Quaid!
What did Quaid-e-Azam love to do?
In which year was Pakistan created?
